lead: A `Core` class whose every member needs a store cannot meet the conformance floor with a happy path; the floor is a gate, not a target.
body: `conformance_coverage.rs` fails `cargo test -p nvs-stdlib` below three `.nvst` cases per member, so a `Core\Session` row cannot land before its cases. Plan each member with its refusals: no `[session]` block, an unreachable backend, a call before `start`.
